Mara visited the old harbor to review the work with the local team. They
discussed how the paper would be stored and which tasks could be finished
before the visitors arrived. One person kept a written record while the
others checked each part of the plan. They noticed that the labels were easy
to read from either side. Nobody hurried the inspection, because a small
correction made early would save a larger repair later. Before leaving, they
agreed to return the next morning and compare the results with their notes.

Jonas visited the railway shelter to review the work with the local team.
They discussed how the clay would be stored and which tasks could be
finished before the visitors arrived. One person kept a written record while
the others checked each part of the plan. They noticed that the path

discussed how the wool would be stored and which tasks could be finished
before the visitors arrived. One person kept a written record while the
others checked each part of the plan. They noticed that the shelves left
enough room for every box. Nobody hurried the inspection, because a small
correction made early would save a larger repair later. Before leaving, they
agreed to return the next morning and compare the results with their notes.

discussed how the chalk would be stored and which tasks could be finished
before the visitors arrived. One person kept a written record while the
others checked each part of the plan. They noticed that the gates opened
without catching their hinges. Nobody hurried the inspection, because a
small correction made early would save a larger repair later. Before
